title: Doge and Senate (subscribed Marco Ottobon) to Giovanni Mocenigo, 27 April 1589, BNE Mss/994 ff. 34-38

documents.route: Venice -> Giovanni Mocenigo, ambassador in France

plaintext.source: Valle de la Cerda's solution is lost; the register copy (ASVe Senato Secreta 1589) was not consulted.

transcription.source: BNE Digital viewer images (about 130 dpi) downloaded by Daniel
transcription.notes: First pass, about 70 % reliable per token; confusions h20/h50/h52/h22, 1/7, 2/9, 3/5.

system.summary: Venetian letter-plus-figure nomenclator of the Zifra Prima type: base letters a c d f g h with figures 1-99 for letters, syllables and words mixed.
system.sibling_key: Zifra Prima sheets DECODE R1789/R1790 (ASVe CX Cifre b. 4 r. 16 ff. 64, 79) identified from Tomokiyo's description, not obtained
system.notes: Composition inferred from statistics (IC 0.0135, figures on every base letter, not N.11); nothing decoded.

prior_solution.where: Valle de la Cerda read it c. 1589 but the solution is lost

conditions.human_role: Downloaded the BNE viewer images behind the Cloudflare check.

solution.what: BNE and DECODE image routes tried by script; Cloudflare Turnstile and DECODE login block them.
Catalogue, people, Venetian zifra granda syllabary (Bonavoglia) recorded as a candidate key.
All seven cipher pages transcribed at first pass, 1,528 tokens; clear passages read.
Figure distribution rules out N.11 and matches the 1577-78 Zifra Prima type.
Letter and letter-plus-wildcard annealers on matched synthetic nomenclators recover 0-9 % of letters.
Same annealers on the target give vowel or syllable soup, no separation from shuffles.

outcome.method_basis: All seven cipher pages (1,528 tokens) were transcribed from the BNE images and attacked ciphertext-only as a Venetian letter-plus-figure nomenclator; Valle de la Cerda's contemporary solution is lost and no key was found.
outcome.notes: Routes: key sheets DECODE R1789/R1790, register copy in ASVe Senato Secreta 1589, or a 300-dpi scan.
